evidence.evidence_text: Dataset condensation has emerged as a promising technique to improve data efficiency under limited data budgets.
In this paper, we introduce CondenseLM, a novel paradigm for both effective and efficient text-level dataset condensation.
However, when applied to the text level, existing methods struggle to compress more information into samples through optimization.
